title: Move records/ readers to athena/records worktree with per-reader tests
summary: Retry of job 20261026-155343-tvfc (D111 job 7 part 2): move every reader of records/ to the athena/records worktree with in-tree fallback, and prove each reader with a worktree test and a fallback test. Planning failed because xtask's walltime reader is unreachable from an athena-cli integration test; this reading puts that pair inside xtask and states what land_pr, audit, auditor and status tests observe. Audience: Athena operators and the verifier.

defaults_applied.how: All changes and tests are Rust.
Per-reader tests plus full cargo test, clippy -D warnings and fmt --check.
Tests assert the worktree record is returned versus the in-tree record, via planted markers.
Criteria name runnable cargo commands, including running the built binary through tests.
Criterion that status and forecast succeed on a checkout with no records/.
One chooser point in paths.rs, plus the scan to catch any missed reader.
Change description cites commands actually run and maps readers to tests.
Decisions and CHANGELOG written for an outside reader.
Test fixtures use synthetic data only, in temporary directories.
records_reader_scan enforces the reader rule with a planted-read test.
BRIEF.md asks for tagged releases and a changelog, so the change records itself in CHANGELOG.md.

assumptions: Production move is as in the previously accepted reading: one point in crates/athena-data/src/paths.rs chooses the records root (worktree under the state directory if present, else in-tree records/).

xtask has no lib target and athena-cli does not depend on it, so worktree_walltime/fallback_walltime live in xtask's own tests (next to linked_worktree_walltime); this is a stated deviation from the single test file.

land_pr's helpers (Rig, FakeHost) are cfg(test) in gh.rs, so its worktree/fallback pair is tested inside gh.rs, observing that resolve(job_ref) succeeds for the worktree-only job id and fails with 'unknown job' for the in-tree-only id, using a runner that refuses every call.
status and audit tests run the athena binary and match a planted job id that exists only in the worktree (or only in-tree for fallback) in the output; auditor tests observe the same planted marker.
Common-dir derivation in backtest.rs and walltime.rs is new code via git's common-dir, not a repair of existing code; the change description says so.
Tests create the worktree under a temporary state directory, never the real state root.
xtask/src/site.rs reads studies/ and stays untouched; the scan covers real readers only, including fully qualified calls like crate::store::Records::load(.
Governance files are not changed; athena-gate/src/audit.rs is missing in this snapshot, so the audit reader is located by grep and modified wherever it actually lives.

acceptance_criteria.text: For each athena-cli-reachable reader (Records::load_current, RecordSet::load_current, read_records, introspect walks, scoring, forecasting, retry carry, auditor, proposals, backtest), a named worktree test in crates/athena-cli/tests/records_branch_readers.rs (or the owning crate where private helpers require it) plants different records in the worktree and in-tree and asserts the worktree's are returned. Run cargo test --locked.
For each of the same readers, a named fallback test with no worktree asserts in-tree records/ is used and the result equals the pre-change result. Run cargo test --locked.

xtask's own tests contain worktree_walltime and fallback_walltime, plus a linked-worktree test that finds the records worktree via git's common dir. Run cargo test -p xtask --locked and confirm a nonzero number of tests ran.

land_pr tests (in gh.rs) show resolve(job_ref) succeeds for the worktree-only job id and fails with 'unknown job' for the in-tree-only id, and the reverse under fallback. Run cargo test --locked land_pr.

A test runs the built athena binary's status, audit and a forecast on a scratch checkout whose working tree has no records/, asserts success, and matches a planted job id from the worktree in status and audit output, with output matching the records/ run. Run cargo test --locked.

Tests create the records worktree under a temporary state directory; scoring's use of the worktree regardless of the passed head is documented in docs/decisions.md and covered by a test. Run cargo test --locked.

The xtask records_reader_scan still fails on planted reads (including crate::store::Records::load( paths), ignores citation strings in steward.rs and work_decisions, and allow-list entries are narrowed to call sites where practical. Run cargo test -p xtask --locked records_reader_scan and confirm a nonzero number of tests ran.
cargo fmt --check, cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings and the full cargo test --locked pass; xtask/src/site.rs is unchanged (git diff shows no change).

The change description lists every reader found by grep, maps each to its worktree and fallback test names and the observed marker, states the walltime and land_pr placement deviations, says common-dir derivation is new code, and cites the commands actually run.
CHANGELOG.md records the reader move, the fallback, the allow-list, and that the site generator is out of scope, citing D111.

out_of_scope: Rerooting xtask/src/site.rs (reads studies/, must stay untouched)
Changes to athena.toml, defaults.toml, workflows or other governance files
Planner or plan-check tooling changes proposed by the introspection
Changes to records/ contents or the cutover itself (20261025-001232-vesh)
departures: Larger than the reference: the change touches about 20 files across four crates and needs about 30 per-reader tests, a cold build, and a prior attempt failed in planning.
urgent_reason: Cuts wasted time by fixing the plan's test placement for the xtask walltime and land_pr readers up front, which stopped the previous attempt in its last planning round.
